seed: The rest of 3D on the selection at Next defaults with no flag changed (the user's approved prototype selection-transform.html, 2026-11-01). A busy screenshot with a drop shadow is picked and switched to 3D on the chip: a pill beside the chip shows the camera's perspective, 45° at first. Dragged sideways it scrubs it with dashed lines from the card's corners to where its receding edges meet; Option on an edge pill does the same at a slower rate. A click on the pill opens None, Subtle, Normal, Strong and a slider; the tool bar's Info popover offers the same, saying they change every 3D layer. (Their buttons are not pressed here: a walk's press on a SwiftUI button over the canvas does nothing today, task a-walk-s-press-on-a-picture-tile-swatch-or-colou.) The depth grip pulled up brings the card forward and its shadow falls further off and softer; pushed down, back, the shadow tightens.

steps.note: in 3D the chip has a pill beside it reading 45°, the camera's perspective; the card is tipped and swung
the pill dragged 60 points right scrubbed the perspective from 45° to 75°, dashed lines running from the card's corners to its vanishing point while the button was down
Option on the right edge pill changed the camera's perspective to 105° rather than tipping the card, and one undo took it back to 75°
a click on the pill opened None, Subtle, Normal, Strong and a slider under it, the header saying Perspective and All 3D layers; nothing is lit, since 75° is no preset
the tool bar's Info popover carries the same presets and slider under Perspective, All 3D layers, below the space values
pulled forward the card's shadow falls further off and softer; pushed back it tightens
